derivation: Hand-derived from D-03 and regression test plan T1.10-T1.12. Each holding is marked at the given price with cash 0 and no receivables or liabilities; a position entry with count>1 represents that many distinct one-share holdings. marked_value_priced is the exact sum of shares*price with no per-position quantization. NAV equals that exact sum. nav_reported is money(nav), quantized once at the reporting boundary with ROUND_HALF_UP to paise. per_position_rounding_total is the wrong alternative that quantizes each position before summation; it is recorded to prove the implementation does not use it.

cases.working: Two positions of 1*0.005 each sum exactly to 0.010. NAV=0.010 and money(0.010)=0.01. Quantizing each position first gives 0.01+0.01=0.02, which must not appear as NAV or nav_reported.
Two hundred positions of 1*0.005 each sum exactly to 1.000. NAV=1.000 and money(1.000)=1.00. Quantizing each position first would produce 2.00, which must not appear as NAV or nav_reported.
